findings.title: Request a scope for the GitHub user lookup
findings.body: The authorize URL requests no OAuth scopes, but the next step calls `get_user_info` to fetch the authenticated user from GitHub’s `/user` endpoint, which requires a user profile scope such as `read:user`. A token issued with no scopes can be denied by that endpoint, preventing installations from completing; the tests stub `/user` and do not catch this real API behavior.

findings.title: New installations can bypass the installer identity check
findings.body: This comparison runs only when an `Integration` already exists. For a new installation whose GitHub installation webhook has not yet created that row, the earlier `Integration.DoesNotExist` branch advances the pipeline and creates the integration without comparing the authenticated user to the webhook sender. Because webhook delivery is asynchronous, a user mismatch can be accepted during that race; the pipeline needs to validate the identity before proceeding even when the integration row is absent.
